استعجلا (form X)
# اِسْتَعْجَلَا (istaʕjalā) /is.taʕ.d͡ʒa.laː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَعْجَلَ (istaʕjala)
# اُسْتُعْجِلَا (ustuʕjilā) /us.tuʕ.d͡ʒi.laː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَعْجَلَ (istaʕjala)
# اِسْتَعْجِلَا (istaʕjilā) /is.taʕ.d͡ʒi.laː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَعْجَلَ (istaʕjala)
